thread:
Alex: quick design review — mini sampler affordance on the compact timeline. noticed it's hard to hit on mobile and contrast is pretty low in dark mode. also overlay sometimes blocks the scrubber when expanded.
Maya: @Alex can you drop the Figma link? saw this in staging too. our label contrast is around 3:1 which fails WCAG for small text. :a11y: :eyes:
Alex: link: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/sampler-compact — screenshot attached (image-2026-03-23-09.png). measured touch target ~24px on mobile.
Alex: proposal: keep visual dot small but make hit area >= 44px. also think we need clearer affordance so people know to drag vs tap.
Kevin: +1 to 44px. dev note: use invisible hit padding rather than scaling the visual to avoid layout shifts. `::before` trick works. also need keyboard focus state (tab) and visible focus ring.
Jess: copy thought — tooltip currently just says "Sampling". Suggest: "Sampling: Auto — preserves latency targets" and a compact variant for narrow widths: "Sampling: Auto". for aggressive mode: "Aggressive — lower fidelity, lower cost". keep it short in the UI.
Maya: UX nit: when sampling is reduced we still display a full heatmap which is misleading. can we add a tiny badge on the heatmap legend showing sampling rate (eg "1/10" or "10%") so people know not all points are present?
DesignBot: [image-diff] contrast delta + proposed focus ring mock. also a quick CSS snippet suggestion:

```
:root { --sampler-hit: 44px; }
.sampler { position: relative; width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.sampler::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; border-radius: 50%; }
```

Kevin: + accessibility: add `role="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Sampling: Auto"` on the control and ensure when it's keyboard-focused the live region announces the new mode. avoid role=slider unless it actually adjusts a continuous value.
Alex: action items — agree on these then we can ship small patch:
1) increase hit target to 44px via invisible padding (owner: Kevin)
2) add visible focus + aria labels (owner: Kevin)
3) update tooltip copy + responsive variants (owner: Jess)
4) show sampling rate badge in heatmap legend (owner: Maya)
5) update figma + deliver assets (owner: Maya)

Jess: I'll draft the microcopy and i18n-safe variants, post by EOD.
Maya: I'll update Figma, push a contrast pass for dark/light, and mock the legend badge.
Kevin: I'll prototype the `::before` hit area and the focus ring in a small PR. will coordinate with Maya for spacing.
Alex: thanks all — quick sync at 2pm PT to sign off on designs? :thumbsup:
Maya: 2pm works for me.
Jess: can do. will bring copy variants.
DesignBot: scheduled calendar invite created for 2026-03-23 14:00 PT.
Alex: awesome — closing thread for now. will reopen if anything blocks.
